messages:
Alex K: Quick sync — SOC2/ISO control mapping. Need owners for two items: audit log collection (control: CC-7) and key rotation policy (CC-12). Also blocked on eng-infra for log ingest schema. Who can own mapping + timeline?
Maria G: I can take audit log collection owner for now. Can you add the spreadsheet link? I'll start a mapping tab. :+1:
Samir: tagging @Maria G — thanks. Quick Q: what retention window are we targeting for SOC2? 1 year or 2? This affects storage sizing for the ingest pipeline.
Alex K: Let's plan for 1 year retention as baseline; note in the sheet we might need to bump to 2y for certain customers. I'll add that note.
Jess L: Heads up — there's an open PR that changes the log event schema (https://git/repo/pull/432). If eng-infra doesn't land that, ingest will fail schema validation. I can rebase and push fixes today.
Maria G: Good catch. @Jess L can you drop a short summary in the mapping sheet of the schema changes so infra knows what to expect?
Jess L: Done — short summary + example events added in the sheet. Also pasting the validation rule here:
```
// schema snippet
required: ["timestamp","service","level","message","trace_id"]
level: enum["debug","info","warn","error"]
```
Samir: Thanks. For KMS key rotation (CC-12) — who owns the rotation automation? I thought infra owns rotation orchestration, security owns policy.
Alex K: Correct — infra implements rotation, security defines policy and approval windows. I propose owners: Infra = "Samir" (implementation), Security = "Alex K" (policy). Agree?
Samir: Agree. I'll draft a playbook and a short runbook for emergency key rollback.
Maria G: For dependencies, add a row: PR 432 -> infra schema deploy -> mapping sign-off. Target milestone: next sprint end (2 weeks).
InfraBot: deploy-bot: schema-lint pipeline passed for feature/log-schema on staging at 2026-03-16T10:02:11Z :white_check_mark:
Jess L: Rebased and fixed tests, requesting review from @Samir and @Maria G. If approved I'll merge and schedule infra deploy.
Alex K: Action items: 1) Maria — create mapping tab + note retention (in progress). 2) Samir — draft rotation playbook (owner). 3) Jess — merge PR 432 and coordinate deploy. 4) Alex — finalize control owners and send to compliance by Friday.
Maria G: I'll ping product if we need to extend retention for any customers.
Samir: I'll estimate storage impact and post numbers by EOD.
Alex K: Thanks all — will update the SOC2 tracker once owners are confirmed. :rocket:
